'''Dru Gifford''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]], stationed at [[Eyrie Base]]. He served during the time between the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He died in a [[Raid on an Imperial supply carrier|raid]] on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Firepower" />
